assessments.reasoning: The general language syntax bullet in Oracle's §1.7.1 explicitly classifies double-quoted content as identifiers and restricts string delimiters to single quotes when ANSI_QUOTES is enabled.

challenge.method: Compared the enabled and default modes in §1.7.1 and checked §1.7's distinction between the global and session mode. Compared enabling ANSI_QUOTES with the composite ANSI mode and the --ansi startup option shown on physical page 80.
challenge.results: The quote rule is tied to the effective ANSI_QUOTES mode. The default admits both string delimiters, the composite mode enables additional options, and the startup option also changes isolation.

limitations: The finding is about lexical classification under the effective SQL mode. Identifier validity and other ANSI settings have separate rules.
